name: Fujicolor Superia X-TRA 400
source: Fuji Photo Film Co., Ltd., FUJICOLOR SUPERIA X-TRA 400 [CH] Product Information Bulletin, Ref. No. AF3-151E (EIGI-03.2, 2003-02)

notes.characteristic: Exposure daylight, 1/125 s, process CN-16, Status M densitometry. No reference log exposure for a normally exposed neutral is printed.
notes.sensitivity: Process CN-16, Status M, density 1.0 above D-min; relative sensitivity (log) = reciprocal of the exposure (J/cm2) required. Only a 1.0 log bracket is printed, so 0.0 and 1.0 are the bracketing gridlines (relative, not absolute). A fourth, dashed cyan-sensitive layer is also plotted; it is dropped (null) because the model uses three layers.
notes.dye_density: Spectral diffuse density, typical densities for a mid-scale neutral subject and for D-min (no per-dye curves published).

grain.note: Diffuse RMS granularity value; micro-densitometer measurement aperture 48 µm diameter, magnification 12x, sample density 1.0 above minimum density.
